e1_dyads_reconciliation.explanation: rq1_effects.csv reports unique fix_dyad_ids (10,941) across u_e1 (13,403 exposure rows), whereas companion pure_model_switch reported exposure rows (u_pure = 12,984 exposure rows across 10,565 unique fix_dyad_ids); removing 419 organic-crossing exposure rows shrinks 13,403 exposure rows to 12,984 exposure rows (and shrinks 10,941 unique fix_dyad_ids to 10,565).
